history.remarks: Initial release — Employee management, General Services, IPCR, Library, Document Tracking, and Dashboard analytics.

IPCR: fixed weighted average calculations (Strategic 30%, Core 55%, Support 15%) across DC and PMT modules; PMT Show page redesigned to match Employee IPCR format; print no longer includes sidebar; status badges unified across all PM pages; OCD now sees all Division Chiefs plus own division subordinates; Memo Report rating period now populated from database.
